title: The Whole Police Force Walked Out Because Kira Might Know Their Faces . . . (Episode 3)
caption:
The police just quit, and Ryuk offered Jack half of his life for a pair of eyes. 😱 Death Note, episode 3. Follow for episode 4!

#deathnote #anime #animerecap #animeexplained #recap #fyp
comment: Would you give up half your life for the eyes? Tell me below!

segments.say: The police task force just walked out on the case, because they were afraid of *Kira*.
To see how it got here, go back to a room full of *detectives*.
The police have a simple problem. They are hunting a killer with no *face*.
Thousands of calls came in. Most were pranks, and twenty-one people even claimed to *be* Kira.
Then the dead start to tell a story. Most of them died late in the *evening*.
So the police begin to wonder if Kira is just a *student*.
L speaks to them from a screen, with only a single *letter*.
He says Kira thinks like a child, with a very simple idea of *justice*.
A young cop admits something. Violent crime has dropped all over the *country*.
Everyone in the room knows what that really means. Kira is *working*.
L has one more request. Check whether the victims' faces were shown on *television*.
Meanwhile, Jack helps his little sister with her *homework*.
He looks calm, like a boy with nothing to *hide*.
Then his father walks in. He is tired, and his new case is very *hard*.
Jack smiles. Daddy is a policeman, which makes this *easy*.
That night, he hacks into his father's computer and copies every *file*.
The police have started to suspect a *student*.
Jack does not panic. He sits down with Ryuk and studies the *rules*.
He can write the cause of death first, and the exact time of death *later*.
Ryuk grins. He is about to get more *entertainment*.
Then, in a prison, an inmate suddenly *stops*. His heart gives out.
One by one, the criminals fall, all within the same *hour*.
Twenty-three victims yesterday. Twenty-three more the day *before*.
Kira is killing one person every hour, on the hour, like a *clock*.
L sees it differently. Kira is *telling* them something.
He can kill from a distance, and he can choose the exact *time*.
And the killings changed pace as soon as the police named a *student*.
L says this can only mean one thing. Kira can read the police *files*.
It is a direct challenge, and L takes it *personally*.
Jack knew this would happen. He left fifty criminals alive on *purpose*.
He wants L to suspect the police, and he wants *more*.
His real goal is to get close to L, so he can *eliminate* him.
Jack explains it to Ryuk. Nobody in this world truly trusts *anyone*.
L will investigate the police, and the police will start to investigate *L*.

segments.text: I'm not the one who's going to find L. I can let the police do that for me.

segments.say: But the police are scared, and the fear spreads *fast*.
The officers tell their chief they want a different case, or they hand in their *badges*.

segments.text: Isn't it clear? It's because we value our lives, sir.

segments.say: They point out that Kira knows their names and *faces*. Anybody could find them.
They do not want to be the next *victims*. And they walk out the door.
The chief is left alone, with a task force that is *falling* apart.
But L is not worried. He has already flown in the *FBI*.
Their job is to gather intel on every cop with access to the *case*.
A hundred and forty-one people. Somewhere on that list is the *killer*.
That night, Ryuk breaks his silence. He says he is not on anyone's *side*.
But he has a warning, and it is a *scary* one.

segments.text: You're being followed by another human. He's watching you right now.

segments.say: Ryuk hates it. He feels like he is being *watched* too.
Jack goes cold. Is L already looking at the *police*?
If he is, one of those spies could work out who he *is*.
And Jack needs one thing right now. The stalker's *name*.
So Ryuk shares a secret. A god of death can never *die*.
Every name they write adds years to their own *life*.
Jack, as a human, can write a thousand names, and gain *nothing*.
But the second difference is even worse. Ryuk can see a name above every *head*.
He can see how many years a person has *left*.
Jack hears it and sits up straight. Now he *understands*.
And there is a way for a human to have the same eyes. For a *price*.
The price is half of his remaining *life*.
Fifty years left becomes twenty-five. One year becomes six *months*.
Jack understands. Ryuk will not give him names, so he has to *pay*.

segments.text: Give me half your remaining lifespan, and I'll give you the Shinigami eyes.

segments.say: With those eyes, Jack could kill anyone just by looking at their *face*.
Jack stares at the grinning god. One question hangs in the air. Is it a *deal*?
